gap: No result ChatGPT got says that SUPCASE's UB Pro, ChatGPT's $32.79 budget pick, 'does NOT support MagSafe' while the other three picks are sold as MagSafe. None of them says that each UB Pro fits only one size pair (iPhone 18 Pro/17 Pro, or 18 Pro Max/17 Pro Max) and that SUPCASE says it is not designed for the base iPhone 17.
standout_why: I read the cited rottenwifi.com 'best protective phone cases' page (2026-08-16). It never says a pick lacks MagSafe. It mentions iPhone 18 only through one Amazon listing title ('UAG Monarch Pro for iPhone 18 Pro Case/iPhone 17 Pro Case') and gives no model exclusions. Macworld's 'Best iPhone 17 cases' (in the results, uncited, updated 2026-09-10) does not mention the iPhone 18 Pro or SUPCASE. Its only model limits are for other brands (Spigen Classic LS, Nomad, Apple Silicone). I could not open the two cited pages, Travel + Leisure and Good Housekeeping. The fetch tool was refused and the curl download needed approval, so I can't rule out that they mention UB Pro's lack of MagSafe. rottenwifi's summary of T+L doesn't mention it.
decides: This keeps OtterBox Defender Series Pro as the top pick and changes the budget slot. A shopper who uses MagSafe chargers, wallets or mounts (the Qi2 and MagSafe gear Dealectric lists from ESR and UGREEN) should not buy the plain UB Pro. SUPCASE's own MagSafe alternative is the UB Grip Pro MagSafe at $43.99 for the same 18 Pro/17 Pro size. For the 'which iPhone do you have' question ChatGPT asked: a Pro-size case listed for '18 Pro / 17 Pro' fits both phones. A base iPhone 17 case (ChatGPT's OtterBox card was for the base iPhone 17) and any Pro Max case do not.

findings.product: general (iPhone 17 Pro vs iPhone 18 Pro case fit)
findings.label: Body sizes, camera bump, and what case makers said
findings.value: 17 Pro and 18 Pro: both 150 × 71.9 × 8.75 mm. 17 Pro Max and 18 Pro Max: both 163.4 × 78 × 8.75 mm. The 18 Pro camera bump is about 0.5 mm taller. OtterBox: its 18 Pro/Max cases are 'also compatible with iPhone 17 Pro, so the cases can be used interchangeably'. Rokform: its older 17 Pro cases are 'not compatible with iPhone 18 models due to camera plateau design differences'.
findings.source_title: Popping your iPhone 18 Pro into last year's case? Not so fast (Simon Jary, Macworld, updated 2026-09-21)
findings.note: Macworld took the dimensions from Apple's tech specs. Apple does not publish the bump height. Native Union told Macworld that a 17 Pro case on an 18 Pro is 'less optimized' because the lens may sit 'almost touching the surface'. Macworld's advice is to buy a case labelled for the iPhone 18 Pro.
